chains.name: Taleteller's Cadence
chains.description: For each stack of [Tale] consumed, Yugu gains a (Magic Resistance *100%) shield for 5 seconds, stacking up to (Magic Resistance *500%). While the shield is active, Yugu is immune to control effects.

chains.name: Echoes to the Horizon
chains.description: When an allied Sinner with [Heed] effect and of the same class as Yugu lands a critical hit, restores 1 Energy. This effect can only be triggered once every 3 seconds.

chains.name: Silver-Tongued
chains.description:
At the start of the battle, Yugu gains 3 stacks of [Tale].
For every 45 Energy cumulatively consumed by allied Sinners, Yugu gains 1 additional stack of [Tale].

buffs.description:
Yugu continuously extracts power from [Tale] and applies it to allied Sinners. While the Ultimate is effective, all allied Sinners except Yugu receive the [Heed] effect, increasing their CRIT Rate by ?% and skill damage by ?%.
[Gavel Thud] consumes 1 stack of [Tale] every 3 seconds during its effective period, and ends when there are no more [Tale] stacks to consume, when Yugu is affected by any control effect, or when Yugu performs other actions.

While [Gavel Thud] is effective, Yugu conjures the power of a [Fox Spirit] to aid her.
[Fox Spirit]: Yugu stores ?% of the CRIT Damage dealt by allied Sinners with the [Heed] effect. Every 2 seconds, she consumes 100% of the stored value and deals equivalent Magic Damage, which is split among enemies within the 3x3 square around her. This damage is not affected by other effects.

While [Gavel Thud] is effective, Yugu conjures the power of a [Golden Oriole] to aid her.
[Golden Oriole]: When allied Sinners with the [Heed] effect land a critical hit, they receive a (Yugu's Magic Resistance *?%) shield, which lasts until the end of the battle. The shield can be stacked to up to 300% of Yugu's Magic Resistance.
